about: Third-party npm packages SecuRAX depends on or tells you to install, pinned. `./securax inspect --watch` compares each pin with the registry; when a newer version exists it inspects BOTH inside the REA sandbox and reports what the new one can do that the old one could not.

packages.name: opencode-ai
packages.why: the OpenCode terminal agent that `./securax opencode` launches (MIT). It ships an install-time script that fetches a platform binary: accepted by a human on 14 Oct 2026; only CHANGES to it are reported.

packages.name: rea-agents
packages.why: REA, the engine of `./securax inspect` (MIT). Pinned by lockfile in integrations/rea; official sources are github.com/morluto/rea, rea.tools and this npm package.
